an6.109:1.5: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya tayo dhammā bhāvetabbā.
an6.109:1.7: kāmavitakkassa pahānāya nekkhammavitakko bhāvetabbo. vyāpādavitakkassa pahānāya avyāpādavitakko bhāvetabbo vihiṃsāvitakkassa pahānāya avihiṃsāvitakko bhāvetabbo.
an6.109:1.8: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya ime tayo dhammā bhāvetabbāti.
